title: Restroom Archive
summary: Restroom Archive is a community-driven website that archives and provides access to public restroom location information and ratings. The platform appears to be a crowdsourced database helping users find and review bathrooms in various locations, gaining modest traction on Hacker News with 183 points and 44 comments.
problem_solved: Helps people quickly find and access information about nearby public restrooms with user-contributed ratings and reviews.
why_valuable: Addresses a common but often overlooked daily need by providing a centralized, community-verified resource for locating public facilities worldwide.
